parameters.content:
### JIRA Branch (v2.2)
✅ Extract JIRA content — parses epicTitle, tasks[], subtasks[] from PRD markdown
✅ HITL approval form — presenter approves before tickets are created
✅ Check JIRA Approval — IF Decision='approve' (case-insensitive) → create tickets ELSE skip
✅ Create EPIC — summary=[PRD] epicTitle, description from Product Overview
✅ Loop Over Tasks — iterates all FR items
✅ Create Parent Task — parentIssueKey=epicKey
✅ Loop Over Subtasks — iterates all TC items per task
✅ Create Sub Task — parentIssueKey=taskKey, assigned to Basic Coding Agent

📝 SETUP: Create n8n credential 'Rakuten AI Gateway' (openAiApi type) with your RAKUTEN_AI_GATEWAY_KEY

parameters.content:
## Entry Webhook
Sets welcome message via initialMessages. sessionId originates here from the chat widget if the user has an existing session, otherwise generated downstream.

## Prepare Input
Filters bot/system messages. Replaces `Date.now()` session IDs with `crypto.randomUUID()` to avoid collisions. Sets `mode=analyze`.

## Parse Agent Response (Core Router)
- `GENERATE_PRD:` signal → `action=generate`
- PRD complete (>2000 chars + 4 sections) → `action=done`
- Default → `action=continue`
- Placeholder guard rejects MyApp/unnamed context

## Action Router (Switch)
- output[0] `trigger_generation` → PRD generation loop
- output[1] `process_prd` → email + JIRA flow
- fallback → Continue Chat (NoOp)

## Validate PRD Quality
Scores 0–100: 50 pts = 8 section patterns, 30 pts = test case count (15+ = full), 20 pts = length (>5000 = full). Grade A–F.

## ⚠️ WAIT NODE
Execution suspends here. Resumes when user submits form at `resumeFormUrl`. **24h timeout** — expires and routes to done if not submitted.

## Extract JIRA Content
Parses PRD markdown: epicTitle from `**Project Name**`, tasks from `FR\d+`, subtasks from `TC\d+`. Max 5 tasks, 10 subtasks. Falls back to synthetic items if none found.
